AIRPORT SERVICES AGREEMENT

1. AIRPORT CHARGES
The Airline shall pay airport charges on 20 April 2027.

2. RUNWAY SERVICES
The Airport shall provide runway services daily.

3. OPERATIONAL NOTICE
If the runway remains closed, the Airport shall notify the Airline within 5 days.

4. INSURANCE
The Airline shall maintain aviation liability insurance of not less than USD 25,000,000 and provide renewal evidence annually.

5. LIABILITY AND INDEMNITY
The Airport indemnifies the Airline for all losses arising from negligent airport services.

6. RENEWAL NOTICE
The Agreement automatically renews for one year unless the Airline provides notice 90 days before expiry.
